$comment: Equipment rules read out of bootfile.dol. Authority for how the engine treats items, levels and slots.

equipGate.note: The cap compares the ITEM's ITEMMINLEVEL to the school's tier, not to the unit's level. Gear written into a roster's ITEMSCOMP is applied directly and is not gated by this path at all.

inputs.item7: Style   (Plain, Light, Medium, Heavy, Archer, ...) from items.tok

categoryCheck.matches: each ITEMCAT entry of the class: type must equal item5, subtype must equal item6 unless the category is the wildcard (byte 1, '<Any>'), style must equal item7
categoryCheck.note: There is no code path that reads the bracketed tag in an itemset row.

itemsetStorage.note: The packer matches and discards the [Tag], so unititems.idx carries no slot information. Classifying an itemset row must use the item's Type from items.tok.
itemsetStorage.vanillaAgreement: all 9,912 rows carry a tag equal to their item's Type, so the tag is redundant but never load-bearing

itemsComp.validation: none: the engine does not check that the item in the weapon position is a weapon
itemsComp.consequence: an item written in the wrong position occupies that slot; a unit without a usable weapon does not attack
